en: Black‑and‑white view of a large Gothic‑style church with two tall, slender towers crowned by steep spires and pinnacles. The building features tall pointed-arch windows with tracery and a steeply pitched roof. In the foreground there is a landscaped garden with paths, low stone walls, shrubs, and a rustic wooden fence. The perspective is from slightly below, looking up at the church; no printed text is visible on the image side.
